title: Fractured Film Sequence
description: A woman in a vintage black dress and hat sits alone in a decaying movie theater, holding a film reel while reaching toward a giant shattered movie screen. The screen displays a broken portrait of a glamorous woman with curly dark hair, a pearl necklace, and puzzle pieces, surrounded by film strips and cracks.
prompt: A lone woman in a 1940s black dress and hat sits in a dilapidated movie theater aisle, holding a film reel and reaching toward a massive shattered cinema screen. The screen shows a glamorous woman's portrait with curly hair and pearl necklace, fractured like broken glass with missing puzzle pieces and film strips. Red curtains, dusty seats, fallen clock and picture frame on the floor, dramatic volumetric lighting, moody and surreal atmosphere.
